page.layout: One page of text, a single column of dictionary entries with Hebrew headwords at the left and Latin glosses. Running head centred at top ("אב"), page number "4" at top right. Catchword "אבנט" at bottom right.

main_text.p: אבט אַבְטִיחִים Pepones. Quidam volunt esse Nomen quatuor literarum. Vide infra in בטח.
אבך Hithpah. התאבך Elevari, Elevare se: Futur. ויתאבכו Elevabunt se, juxta Aben Esram, Jesa.9. v.18. Quidam; In minutissimum pulverem abibunt, quasi ab אָבָק Caph & Koph permutatu.

אבל Luxit, In luctu fuit: Tribuitur etiam metaphoricè Inanimatis. Præter. אבל תירוש Luget mustum, Jes.24.7. Hiph. האביל Lugere fecit, Luctum attulit. Præt. האבלתי Luctum attuli, Ezech.31.15. Fut. ויאבל־חיל Et luctum attulit munitioni, Thren.2.8. Hithpah. Præt. התאבל Luxit, 1.Sam.15.35.

m. Lugens; at 1.Sam.6.18. juxta paraphrasten Chald. & R.Sal. ponitur pro אבן Lapis, ut ex v.15. liquet. Proprium nomen loci; à Luctu sic dicti; Genes.50.11. Constr. באבל־אם Sicut lugens matris, Psal.35.14. Plurale, אבלים Lugentes: Constr. לאבלי ציון Lugentibus Tzionis, Jesa.61.3. Fœm. Plural. אבלות Thren.1.4.
אבל Ar, Ast, Sed, Verùm, Veruntamen, Immò. אובל Vide in יבל.

אבן f. Lapis; metonymicè, Pondus, Deut.25. v.13. Perpendiculum: Massa, ut Lapis plumbi, Zach.5.7. Lapis stanni, Zach.4.19. Aff. אבנו Lapidè suum; 2.Reg.3.25. Chald. אבן Lapis, Esræ 5.8. & forma emphatica, אבנא Dan.2.34. Plur. אבנים Lapides; Pondera, Perpendicula: Const. אבני שהם Lapides onyc his, Exod.28.9. Aff. אבניהם Lapidum eorum, Neh.4.3. אבניה Lapides ejus, Deut.8.9.
אבנים m.d. Sellæ parturientium, juxta R.Sal. Exo.1.16. Sella, Tabula figulorum, Jer.18.3. Forma dualis duplæ forma servit: plicatæ enim circumgestantur commoditatis causâ.

page.notes: The Hebrew headword before "Pepones" is partly unclear and is given with [?] in spirit only; no [?] marks were placed in the text for legibility at this scan size. Some Hebrew vowel points and the exact Latin spelling of "Elevabunt", "Jesa" and "permutatu" are read from a small, slightly blurred scan. The Hebrew word "אבט" headword is set in large type. Several Hebrew words in the Latin glosses are small and may contain minor errors in pointing.
